examples.title: Example 1: Displaying an Action Sheet
examples.description: This example demonstrates how to display an action sheet when a button is touched.

examples.title: Example 2: Opening a Dialog Box Outside the Main Window
examples.description: This example demonstrates how to configure a dialog box to display outside the main window on a 2-in-1 device by setting showInSubWindow to true.

examples.title: Example 3: Setting the Dialog Box Animation
examples.description: This example illustrates how to use the transition API to create custom animation effects for the dialog box's appearance and disappearance.

examples.title: Example 4: Setting the Dialog Box Style
examples.description: This example demonstrates how to set styles of a dialog box, including the width, height, background color, and shadow.

examples.title: Example 5: Configuring a Dialog Box in the Hover State
examples.description: This example demonstrates how to set the layout area of a dialog box in hover mode on a foldable device.

examples.title: Example 6: Using Dialog Box Lifecycle Callbacks
examples.description:
This example demonstrates how to configure the lifecycle callbacks for the dialog box.
The onDidAppear, onDidDisappear, onWillAppear, and onWillDisappear properties are supported in ActionSheetOptions since API version 19.

examples.title: Example 7: Customizing the Background Blur Effect
examples.description:
This example demonstrates how to customize the background blur effect by configuring backgroundBlurStyleOptions.
The backgroundBlurStyleOptions property is supported in ActionSheetOptions since API version 19.

examples.title: Example 8: Customizing the Background Effect
examples.description:
This example demonstrates how to customize the background effect by configuring backgroundEffect.
The backgroundEffect property is supported in ActionSheetOptions since API version 19.
